tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the equipment (s) similar to the type specified in the ‘Schedule of Requirements’ up to at least xxxx % of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years. The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after xxxxx and be in satisfactory operation for xxxxx months as on date of tender opening. Certificates to be provided as per Section XII of Tender Document.

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per General Conditions of Contract and Special Conditions of Contract. Manufacturers Authorization Form to be provided as per Section XIII of Tender Document.

In case of authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer - The tenderer, as authorized representative/dealer , has supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least xxxxx % of the quantity similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last three years which must be in satisfactory operation for at least xxxxx months on the date of tender opening. Certificates to be provided as per Section XII of Tender Document.
The legal status, place of registration and principal place of business of the company or firm or partnership.
Details of experience and past performance of the tenderer on equipment offered and on those of similar nature within the past three and details of current contracts in hand and other commitments.
A detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the goods.

A list giving full particulars, including available sources and current prices, of spare parts, special tools, etc., necessary for the proper and continuing functioning of the goods for a period of two years, following commencement of the use of the goods by the Purchaser.

Item-by-item commentary on the Purchaser's Technical Specifications demonstrating substantial responsiveness of the goods and services to those specifications or a statement of deviations and exceptions to the provisions of the Technical Specifications.
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever.
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake.
Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN No. to be furnished along with necessary documents.
Bidder has to quote rates excluding GST, GST shall be paid separately as per applicable.
All the Work done certificate uploaded should include E-procurement indent number.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Authorization certificate Manufacturer or Authorized representative/Dealer

The bidder should have minimum average annual turnover of Rs 10.67 Lakhs, during the last preceding 3 years i.e2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26. However, the average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be Rs 8.54 lakhs with respect to micro and small enterprises during the last two preceding financial years i.e, 2024-25 to 2025-26. Bidder to furnish the following documents for 3 years, 2 years for MSME

The Micro and small Enterprises they should have manufactured, tested and supplied the following items as per Schedule of Requirements at least below mentioned quantity required in any one of the last 2 years 2024-25, 2025-26 to any State/Central/Government Departments/PSU/ULBs in India 1.Chlorine-720 Kg, 2.Bleaching Powders-1800 K,

The tenderer as authorized representative has supplied satisfactorily at least below mentioned quantities of items as per Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last three years 2023-24, 2024-25,2025-26to any State/Central/Government Departments/PSU/ULBS in India 1.Chlorine-540 Kg 2.Bleaching Powders-1350 Kg

The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the all Good similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements upto at least 80 percent of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 1. Chlorine-1440 Kg 2. Bleaching Powders-3600 Kg
The tenderer should furnish the information on all past supplies and satisfactory performance for both a. and b.above, in Proforma under Section XII
The Tenderer should submit industrial safety training certificate furnished for safety handling of Chlorine from any of the reputed industrial safety training organization/consultant
